title: Swarm intelligence–optimized deep neural network for intelligent diagnosis of lithium‑ion battery state of health
summary: Methods build SSA-tuned LSTM state-of-health prediction from NASA and Oxford battery datasets; Results compare against several models across three groups and report measured error metrics. Evidence is dataset validation, not independent deployment.
ai_technology: A neural model estimated lithium-battery state of health from measured performance data. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
